response.sql:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_rating
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.avg_per_day, p.avg_per_day - a.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM per_rating p
  CROSS JOIN averaged a
  WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_per_day IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_per_day > a.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_kept_ratings,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: A film's per-day rental price is rental_rate divided by rental_duration; rating figures are the average of those per-film ratios. Zero durations are treated as missing, though the supplied profile shows durations are positive.
